typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Market as string,
		Address as string,
		Phone as string,
		Service as string,
		PCPFullName as string,
		ProviderLastSeen as string,
		ProviderLastSeenAddress as string,
		ProviderLastSeenPhone as string,
		{Subscriber No} as string,
		{Medicaid No} as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		{Birth Date} as string,
		{Age Band} as string,
		{Age In Years} as string,
		{Age In Months} as string,
		{Due From Date} as string,
		{Due To Date} as string,
		{Minimum Count} as string,
		{Schedule Desc} as string,
		{Previous Service Dates Given} as string,
		AffNum as string,
		{Last Service Date} as string,
		GENDER as string,
		LANGUAGE as string,
		ClaimID as string,
		HOHFamilyLink as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT	DISTINCT CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), Market) AS Market ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), left(Member,9)) AS \'Subscriber No\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ALTKEY) AS \'Medicaid No\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), FirstName) AS \'First Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), LastName) AS \'Last Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Address]) AS Address ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), Phone) AS Phone ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), BirthDate) AS \'Birth Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeBand) AS \'Age Band\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInYears) AS \'Age In Years\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInMonths) AS \'Age In Months\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Service]) AS Service ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), DueFromDate) AS \'Due From Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), DueToDate) AS \'Due To Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), MinimumCount) AS \'Minimum Count\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ScheduleDesc) AS \'Schedule Desc\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PreviousSvcDates) AS \'Previous Service Dates Given\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AffNum) AS AffNum ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PCPFullName) AS PCPFullName		 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ISNULL(LSP.PRPR_NAME,\'\')) AS \'ProviderLastSeen\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ISNULL(LSP.PROVIDER_ADDRESS,\'\'))  AS \'ProviderLastSeenAddress\'	 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ISNULL(LSP.PROVIDERPHONE,\'\')) AS \'ProviderLastSeenPhone\'		 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), LastServiceDate) AS \'Last Service Date\'	 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ClaimID) AS \'ClaimID\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), GENDER) AS \'GENDER\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Language]) AS \'LANGUAGE\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [HOHFamilyLink]) AS \'HOHFamilyLink\'		 FROM  ##POSTCARDOVERDUE PO LEFT JOIN   ##LASTSEENPROVIDER LSP ON   PO.CLAIMID = LSP.CLCL_ID WHERE	 AgeBand = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Address} = toString(Address),
		{Copy of Service} = toString(Service),
		{Copy of AffNum} = toString(AffNum),
		{Copy of ClaimID} = toString(ClaimID),
		{Copy of GENDER} = toString(GENDER),
		{Copy of ProviderLastSeenPhone} = toString(ProviderLastSeenPhone),
		{Copy of Market} = toString(Market),
		{Copy of ProviderLastSeenAddress} = toString(ProviderLastSeenAddress),
		{Copy of PCPFullName} = toString(PCPFullName),
		{Copy of LANGUAGE} = toString(LANGUAGE),
		{Copy of Phone} = toString(Phone),
		{Copy of ProviderLastSeen} = toString(ProviderLastSeen),
		{Copy of HOHFamilyLink} = toString(HOHFamilyLink)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
ExcelDestination derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestinationErrorReformat
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat sink(input(
		ErrorColumn as integer,
		Birth_Date as string,
		Address as string,
		Age_In_Years as string,
		Age_In_Months as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Medicaid_No as string,
		Phone as string,
		PCPFullName as string,
		Subscriber_No as string,
		Due_From_Date as string,
		Minimum_Count as string,
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given as string,
		Service as string,
		Market as string,
		Last_Service_Date as string,
		AffNum as string,
		Schedule_Desc as string,
		Age_Band as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		ProviderLastSeenPhone as string,
		Due_To_Date as string,
		ProviderLastSeenAddress as string,
		ErrorCode as integer,
		ProviderLastSeen as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ErrorColumn,
		Birth_Date = {Birth Date},
		Address,
		Age_In_Years = {Age In Years},
		Age_In_Months = {Age In Months},
		First_Name = {First Name},
		Medicaid_No = {Medicaid No},
		Phone,
		PCPFullName,
		Subscriber_No = {Subscriber No},
		Due_From_Date = {Due From Date},
		Minimum_Count = {Minimum Count},
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given = {Previous Service Dates Given},
		Service,
		Market,
		Last_Service_Date = {Last Service Date},
		AffNum,
		Schedule_Desc = {Schedule Desc},
		Age_Band = {Age Band},
		Last_Name = {Last Name},
		ProviderLastSeenPhone,
		Due_To_Date = {Due To Date},
		ProviderLastSeenAddress,
		ErrorCode,
		ProviderLastSeen)) ~> FlatFileDestination
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestination0
ExcelDestination0 sink(input(
		{} as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{} = ErrorColumn)) ~> ExcelDestinationERROROUTPUTFILE
